sources.name: Conflict Investigations NZZ Maps territory series
sources.role: Occupied-area time series derived by the upstream project

methodology: Normalized from the upstream occupied-area series against 603550 km2. The project adds 2021-12-31 and 2022-02-23 baseline records at 43744 km2 when absent and suppresses implausible upstream spikes above 180000 km2 in the source generator.
license_notice: No blanket license is granted for this collection. Each upstream source retains its own rights and terms. Review the source-specific terms and preserve attribution before reuse.

provenance.methodology: Join records to data by date. Upstream areas are estimates, rounded to two decimals. Missing baseline dates are added by the project. Source areas above the 180000 km2 guard after rounding are replaced by the last valid value; rejected raw values and the true reference date are retained. The guard is a project normalization rule, not a territorial limit. A carried-forward endpoint does not establish an observed daily movement. No missing dates are interpolated.
